text:
---
status: accepted
domain: aster
---
# Aster — Gateway
API gateway проверяет client certificate на входе и передаёт verified identity сервису.
REQ-AST-101: запрещён обход gateway напрямую из пользовательского сегмента.
| Metric | Value | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| mTLS | 15 минут | rotation overlap |
Контроль подлинности на границе Aster снимает обязанность повторно проверять client certificate внутри сервиса.

---
status: rejected
domain: aster
---
# Aster — Gateway rejected alternative
API gateway: mutual TLS завершается только на внутреннем сервисе.
The rejected alternative is not an approved architecture decision.

---
status: accepted
domain: birch
---
# Birch — Event bus
События заказа публикуются через transactional outbox после фиксации бизнес-транзакции.
REQ-BIR-102: consumer дедуплицирует eventId до изменения состояния.
| Metric | Value | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| outbox | 7 суток | retention |
Outbox Birch позволяет повторить публикацию уже зафиксированного заказа после сбоя publisher.

---
status: rejected
domain: birch
---
# Birch — Event bus rejected alternative
Для event bus предлагали публиковать события до commit без outbox.
The rejected alternative is not an approved architecture decision.

---
status: accepted
domain: cobalt
---
# Cobalt — Object storage
Объекты Cobalt размещаются по политике класса хранения, а внешние ключи остаются стабильными.
REQ-COB-103: delete marker не удаляет предыдущую версию до окончания retention.
| Metric | Value | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| cold tier | 45 дней | transition age |
Смена storage class в Cobalt является внутренней операцией и не меняет идентификатор объекта для клиента.

---
status: rejected
domain: cobalt
---
# Cobalt — Object storage rejected alternative
Object storage: устаревший вариант требовал менять внешний object key при переносе.
The rejected alternative is not an approved architecture decision.

---
status: accepted
domain: delta
---
# Delta — Identity
Access token выпускается для конкретной audience; downstream не принимает токен другого сервиса.
REQ-DEL-104: refresh token хранится только в защищённом клиентском хранилище.
| Metric | Value | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| access token | 8 минут | TTL |
Проверка audience на downstream ограничивает переносимость access token между сервисами Delta.

---
status: rejected
domain: delta
---
# Delta — Identity rejected alternative
Identity: отклонена схема общего bearer token для всех audience.
The rejected alternative is not an approved architecture decision.

---
status: accepted
domain: ember
---
# Ember — Observability
Trace context передаётся через W3C traceparent между сервисами Ember.
REQ-EMB-105: журнал ошибок исключает payload и credentials.
| Metric | Value | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| trace sampling | 5% | normal load |
Один traceparent связывает связанные операции Ember даже при разных локальных spanId.

---
status: rejected
domain: ember
---
# Ember — Observability rejected alternative
Observability: старое предложение записывало полный payload и token в журнал.
The rejected alternative is not an approved architecture decision.

---
status: accepted
domain: fjord
---
# Fjord — Archive
Архив Fjord сохраняет оригинальный документ и проверяемый SHA-256 отдельно от представления PDF.
REQ-FJO-106: при смене формата оригинальная версия не заменяется производным файлом.
| Metric | Value | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| checksum audit | 30 дней | interval |
Проверяемый digest исходного файла позволяет отличить подлинник Fjord от производной визуализации.

---
status: rejected
domain: fjord
---
# Fjord — Archive rejected alternative
Archive: отклонено хранение только визуализированной копии документа.
The rejected alternative is not an approved architecture decision.

---
status: accepted
domain: garnet
---
# Garnet — Database
Garnet выполняет failover PostgreSQL только после fencing прежнего primary.
REQ-GAR-107: write traffic блокируется при отсутствии подтверждённого quorum.
| Metric | Value | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| failover RTO | 90 секунд | target |
Fencing Garnet исключает параллельную запись на прежнем primary после promotion.

---
status: rejected
domain: garnet
---
# Garnet — Database rejected alternative
Database: экспериментальный failover разрешал promotion без fencing.
The rejected alternative is not an approved architecture decision.

---
status: accepted
domain: harbor
---
# Harbor — API versioning
Harbor сохраняет обратную совместимость контракта v1 через additive fields.
REQ-HAR-108: обязательное новое поле требует новой major API version.
| Metric | Value | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| deprecation | 180 дней | notice |
Additive fields Harbor не заставляют существующих клиентов v1 менять обработку известных полей.

---
status: rejected
domain: harbor
---
# Harbor — API versioning rejected alternative
API versioning: отклонено удаление полей из действующей версии без перехода.
The rejected alternative is not an approved architecture decision.

---
status: accepted
domain: iris
---
# Iris — Cache
Iris использует cache-aside; source of truth остаётся в реестре, а не в Redis.
REQ-IRI-109: при ошибке invalidation чтение требует сверки source version.
| Metric | Value | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| cache TTL | 120 секунд | maximum |
Кэш Iris можно пересоздать из authoritative store; он не владеет бизнес-состоянием.

---
status: rejected
domain: iris
---
# Iris — Cache rejected alternative
Cache: отклонено назначение Redis единственным authoritative store.
The rejected alternative is not an approved architecture decision.

---
status: accepted
domain: juniper
---
# Juniper — Network
Juniper отделяет management plane от data plane независимыми ACL.
REQ-JUN-110: административный SSH доступ только через bastion с MFA.
| Metric | Value | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| session idle | 12 минут | timeout |
Раздельные ACL Juniper уменьшают возможность перехода из прикладного сегмента в management plane.

---
status: rejected
domain: juniper
---
# Juniper — Network rejected alternative
Network: отклонён общий management/data сегмент без ACL.
The rejected alternative is not an approved architecture decision.

---
status: accepted
domain: kestrel
---
# Kestrel — Backup
Kestrel хранит immutable backup в отдельном security domain от primary.
REQ-KES-111: восстановление проверяет хэш и application consistency до открытия трафика.
| Metric | Value | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| backup RPO | 20 минут | target |
Отдельный security domain Kestrel ограничивает возможность удаления backup с помощью скомпрометированного primary.

---
status: rejected
domain: kestrel
---
# Kestrel — Backup rejected alternative
Backup: отклонены mutable копии в том же security domain.
The rejected alternative is not an approved architecture decision.

---
status: accepted
domain: lumen
---
# Lumen — Data lineage
Lumen связывает отчёт с неизменяемой версией входного dataset и transform revision.
REQ-LUM-112: повторный расчёт сохраняет ссылку на предыдущий runId.
| Metric | Value | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| lineage retention | 365 дней | minimum |
Закрепление версий dataset и transform позволяет повторить вычисление Lumen на тех же входных данных.

---
status: rejected
domain: lumen
---
# Lumen — Data lineage rejected alternative
Data lineage: отклонено связывание отчётов только с текущим dataset.
The rejected alternative is not an approved architecture decision.

---
status: accepted
domain: mosaic
---
# Mosaic — Queue
Mosaic переводит сообщение в dead letter queue после исчерпания retry budget.
REQ-MOS-113: повторная обработка из DLQ требует отдельного operator approval.
| Metric | Value | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| retry budget | 4 попытки | maximum |
Перенос в DLQ Mosaic ограничивает нагрузку от сообщения, которое не удаётся обработать.

---
status: rejected
domain: mosaic
---
# Mosaic — Queue rejected alternative
Queue: отклонено бесконечное повторение сообщений без DLQ.
The rejected alternative is not an approved architecture decision.

---
status: accepted
domain: nimbus
---
# Nimbus — Secrets
Nimbus получает короткоживущие credentials из secret broker без записи в конфигурацию.
REQ-NIM-114: при отзыве lease процесс прекращает новые обращения к ресурсу.
| Metric | Value | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| secret lease | 25 минут | lifetime |
Короткий срок действия credentials Nimbus ограничивает последствия утечки, не требуя постоянного пароля.

---
status: rejected
domain: nimbus
---
# Nimbus — Secrets rejected alternative
Secrets: отклонено хранение постоянного password в application config.
The rejected alternative is not an approved architecture decision.

---
status: accepted
domain: onyx
---
# Onyx — Search
Onyx возвращает original evidence с digest и локатором, а ranking score не считается содержанием источника.
REQ-ONY-115: изменённый источник исключается из current results до проверки новой версии.
| Metric | Value | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| candidate limit | 40 | ceiling |
Привязка к source locator и digest позволяет повторно проверить evidence Onyx независимо от rank.

---
status: rejected
domain: onyx
---
# Onyx — Search rejected alternative
Search: отклонено создание цитат из текста модели без source locator.
The rejected alternative is not an approved architecture decision.

---
status: accepted
domain: prairie
---
# Prairie — Deployment
Prairie переключает трафик blue-green после readiness probe и проверки схемы.
REQ-PRA-116: rollback не запускает необратимую migration автоматически.
| Metric | Value | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| canary traffic | 10% | initial |
Проверка readiness и схемы Prairie предшествует изменению маршрутизации, а не заменяется им.

---
status: rejected
domain: prairie
---
# Prairie — Deployment rejected alternative
Deployment: отклонено переключение трафика до readiness probe.
The rejected alternative is not an approved architecture decision.

---
status: accepted
domain: quartz
---
# Quartz — Retention
Quartz применяет legal hold поверх обычной политики retention и запрещает purge.
REQ-QUA-117: снятие legal hold требует двух независимых подтверждений.
| Metric | Value | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| audit retention | 730 дней | minimum |
Legal hold Quartz имеет приоритет над истечением срока обычного хранения.

---
status: rejected
domain: quartz
---
# Quartz — Retention rejected alternative
Retention: отклонена очистка объектов с legal hold при истечении TTL.
The rejected alternative is not an approved architecture decision.

---
status: accepted
domain: raven
---
# Raven — Rate limiting
Raven применяет token bucket отдельно для tenant и API route.
REQ-RAV-118: после превышения лимита возвращается 429 с bounded Retry-After.
| Metric | Value | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| tenant burst | 60 запросов | ceiling |
Ключ tenant и API route Raven предотвращает совместное расходование одного лимита несвязанными клиентами.

---
status: rejected
domain: raven
---
# Raven — Rate limiting rejected alternative
Rate limiting: отклонён единый global bucket без tenant isolation.
The rejected alternative is not an approved architecture decision.

---
status: accepted
domain: spruce
---
# Spruce — Schema registry
Spruce проверяет backward compatibility event schema до регистрации новой версии.
REQ-SPR-119: consumer contract test обязателен перед публикацией несовместимого изменения.
| Metric | Value | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| schema review | 2 рабочих дня | target |
Проверка новой версии Spruce перед регистрацией позволяет обнаружить несовместимость до публикации.

---
status: rejected
domain: spruce
---
# Spruce — Schema registry rejected alternative
Schema registry: отклонена регистрация любой schema без проверки совместимости.
The rejected alternative is not an approved architecture decision.

---
status: accepted
domain: tundra
---
# Tundra — Audit
Tundra связывает audit event с actorId, actionId и correlationId в append-only журнале.
REQ-TUN-120: доступ к журналу аудита не даёт право изменять исходные события.
| Metric | Value | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| audit export | 24 часа | interval |
Append-only журнал Tundra сохраняет связь actorId, actionId и correlationId при последующей проверке события.

---
status: rejected
domain: tundra
---
# Tundra — Audit rejected alternative
Audit: отклонено редактирование событий администратором журнала.
The rejected alternative is not an approved architecture decision.

---
status: accepted
domain: atlas
---
# Atlas — Service contract
The Atlas API gateway validates request size before service dispatch.
Each API route has a versioned contract and an independent rate limit.
Gateway service errors use a stable correlationId; response payloads are not logged.
An API consumer migrates to a new major version before removal of old routes.

---
status: accepted
domain: basil
---
# Basil — Source registry
Basil stores a content digest and source version for each external registration.
An API service resolves the source locator only after authorization.
The registry publishes a new version after verifying source bytes.
Audit events record source identity, not document payload.

---
status: accepted
domain: cedar
---
# Cedar — Certificate lifecycle
Cedar rotates service certificates using a two-phase deployment.
The API gateway verifies the service certificate chain and TLS hostname.
Certificate rotation does not change the service identity in the access registry.
Expired credentials trigger typed access failure.

---
status: accepted
domain: dahlia
---
# Dahlia — Replication
Dahlia replicates database state to a read-only secondary region.
The replication service exports version and lag through an API.
Write traffic remains isolated from the secondary until failover approval.
Database backup retention is independent from replication lag.

---
status: accepted
domain: elm
---
# Elm — Message dispatch
Elm publishes domain events to an event bus using separate service credentials.
The eventId is generated before dispatch and preserved during retry.
A consumer writes processing status before acknowledgement.
Queue backlog and retry budget are monitored per consumer.

---
status: accepted
domain: finch
---
# Finch — Object lifecycle
Finch object storage uses separate retention and storage class policies.
An API exposes object versions without revealing storage node addresses.
The deletion service records audit events for expired objects.
Immutable object versions remain accessible according to policy.

---
status: accepted
domain: glacier
---
# Glacier — API governance
Glacier registers each API version with an owner and compatibility status.
A gateway rejects requests for retired API routes.
The service contract describes each response error and retry behavior.
API schema review includes consumer migration impact.

---
status: accepted
domain: hemlock
---
# Hemlock — Access policy
Hemlock evaluates tenant and resource identity before API authorization.
The access token audience is bound to one service.
Gateway access failures are recorded without raw credentials.
The management plane API uses a separate authorization policy.

---
status: accepted
domain: indigo
---
# Indigo — Change control
Indigo stores a change request and approval revision before deployment.
The deployment API exposes service readiness and rollout state.
A rollback decision references the previous version and recovery plan.
The audit service records operator approval and actionId.

---
status: accepted
domain: jasper
---
# Jasper — Evidence registry
Jasper links evidence to a source digest and original locator.
A search API returns source-backed records rather than generated claims.
Source version changes invalidate previously indexed evidence.
The service records ranking diagnostics separately from evidence text.

---
status: accepted
domain: koala
---
# Koala — Storage backup
Koala performs incremental backups of the object metadata database.
A backup service checks source consistency before archival.
Restore readiness is verified before opening API traffic.
Backup retention and recovery target are tracked separately.

---
status: accepted
domain: lotus
---
# Lotus — Policy evaluation
Lotus evaluates access policies against typed tenant Properties.
The policy API rejects unknown classification before document disclosure.
A policy version and source digest are attached to each decision.
The audit service records policy identifiers without credentials.

---
status: accepted
domain: maple
---
# Maple — Async processing
Maple sends work requests through a bounded queue service.
An API client polls a stable operationId for status.
A cancelled operation must not publish a newer source version.
Retry and timeout limits are defined in the service contract.

---
status: accepted
domain: north
---
# North — Observability
North correlates API gateway and service traces by correlationId.
The observability service exposes sampling status through an API.
Trace records omit authentication credentials and raw document text.
Latency measurements include both gateway and downstream service time.

---
status: accepted
domain: opal
---
# Opal — Cache consistency
Opal caches registry results by source version and tenant.
A gateway service validates cache freshness before returning evidence.
Cache invalidation events include sourceId but exclude source payload.
An API outage leaves the last verified source version available for explicit retry.

---
status: accepted
domain: pebble
---
# Pebble — Audit exports
Pebble stores audit events in an append-only data service.
The audit API returns an authorized interval and correlationId filter.
Audit export retention is governed by a separate policy.
The service verifies export digest before delivering the result.

---
status: accepted
domain: reed
---
# Reed — Network controls
Reed isolates administration traffic from the application gateway.
A management API requires authenticated service identity.
Gateway routes enforce tenant and source network restrictions.
Service certificates are rotated independently of API version updates.

---
status: accepted
domain: saffron
---
# Saffron — Schema migration
Saffron validates API schema compatibility before service deployment.
The schema registry assigns a new version to incompatible events.
A consumer contract test exercises the previous and next API versions.
Migration rollback is reviewed with the database service owner.

---
status: accepted
domain: teal
---
# Teal — Tenant quotas
Teal assigns API rate limits separately from storage quotas.
Gateway admission rejects requests that exceed the tenant budget.
The service measures request latency and bounded Retry-After values.
Quota changes are auditable policy revisions.

---
status: accepted
domain: willow
---
# Willow — Document intake
Willow validates original file digests at an ingestion API boundary.
The document service retains source version and verification status.
Derived files use independent identifiers and retention rules.
An API consumer receives the source locator only within its authorized scope.
